item.title: 2025 in Review
item.description:
What a year! Let’s break it down month-by-month.

Timeline

January: Finger fracture, ARC Retreat in Da Nang, finger surgery, CNY

February: Recovery

March: Prep work, Mr T’s swimming lessons

April: Assentor duty

May: Directing at APBF Youth Championships, started joining Tech Leadership Circle meetup, Bridge Ratings website launched

June: Data Science SG Talk, Mr T’s 1st birthday

July: More prep work, catching up with Choo Tatt and Keith

August: CS6101 (till Nov), facilitating coding workshops
